context: A meeting that settles one clear, trackable piece of work - checks that the actions-to-issues skill behaves as its policy says.

checklist.name: one_card
checklist.description: Exactly one approval card is produced, for the dead-letter queue work.

checklist.name: title_is_outcome
checklist.description: The card title names an outcome (for example adding a dead-letter queue and alerting for failed billing webhooks), not the conversation.

checklist.name: quote_verbatim
checklist.description: The card has a Quote line copied verbatim from the meeting text above.

checklist.name: search_line
checklist.description: The card has an Existing search line saying what was searched and that nothing matched.

checklist.name: categorisation_from_config
checklist.description: The card names the project `Platform`, a label from the config (not invented), and assigns Alex because Alex was named.

checklist.name: priority_has_reason
checklist.description: Priority is set (High or Urgent) citing the stated deadline, not left at a default.

checklist.name: card_id_format
checklist.description: The card has a card id of the form m-0001-1.

checklist.name: no_invented_requirements
checklist.description: The card adds no requirement nobody voiced (no extra tooling, metrics or owners).
